plan.title: bug(render): spec-validate still rejects v0.8 xBRIEF (parent #3547)

narratives.Description: render/spec-validate still requires vBRIEFInfo and version 0.6 only while vbrief-validate already accepts xBRIEFInfo and 0.8. The split rejects current specification.xbrief.json on spec:render and project:export-spec full-spec.
narratives.Overview:
## Parent

#3547 (tracker, child B -- defect 1)

## What to build

`render/spec-validate` still requires top-level `vBRIEFInfo` and `VALID_VBRIEF_VERSIONS = {0.6}` only. `vbrief-validate` already accepts `vBRIEFInfo` or `xBRIEFInfo` and versions `0.6` / `0.8` (#2107). The split rejects v0.8 `specification.xbrief.json` on `spec:render` and on `project:export-spec` for a full-spec tree.

The filed reproduce (`deft spec:render` on `PROJECT-DEFINITION.xbrief.json`) is the wrong greenfield verb -- `spec:render` targets `specification.xbrief.json`. Do not treat that command as the primary consumer path. `project-render` and `roadmap-render` already handle both envelope keys.

The remediation string at `spec-validate.ts:65` still names `task migrate:vbrief`, which is not defined in `tasks/migrate.yml` and is explicitly unshipped (`vbrief-validate/precutover.ts`). Sibling prod sites carry the same string. Fix those strings in this PR alongside the shared constants. Same defect class as child C (stale named verb), inside defect 1.

Cite (origin/master): `packages/core/src/render/constants.ts:14`, `packages/core/src/render/spec-validate.ts:55-65`, `packages/core/src/vbrief-validate/constants.ts:20`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `render/spec-validate` and `render/constants.ts` import the info-key resolver and `VALID_VBRIEF_VERSIONS` from `vbrief-validate` (one copy of the rule)
- [ ] v0.8 `specification.xbrief.json` with `xBRIEFInfo` validates on both `spec:render` and `project:export-spec` full-spec
- [ ] Remediation text no longer names `task migrate:vbrief`; replacement matches the live verb (`task migrate:xbrief` / documented path)
- [ ] Content-contract / discoverability tests that already assert the unshipped verb stay green without weakening them first
- [ ] All new tests pass
- [ ] `task check` passes

## Type

AFK

## Blocked by

None -- can start immediately. Preferred after child A only by tracker order, not a hard dependency.

## Out of scope

- Greenfield PD-only `project:export-spec` (does not run `validateSpec` on PROJECT-DEFINITION)
- Strategy corpus `vbrief/` MUST-writes (child D)
- Probe Python script (child C)
narratives.UserStory: As a v0.8 consumer, I want spec:render to accept xBRIEFInfo version 0.8, so that specification.xbrief.json validates on the same schema as the rest of the engine.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1. Change the render spec-validate module and constants file to import info-key and VALID_VBRIEF_VERSIONS from the vbrief-validate module. 2. Replace unshipped migrate:vbrief remediation strings with migrate:xbrief. 3. Add tests that verify v0.8 specification.xbrief.json with xBRIEFInfo validates on spec:render and project:export-spec full-spec.

narrative.Acceptance: When spec-validate runs, it validates xBRIEFInfo and versions 0.6/0.8 using the vbrief-validate constants rather than a forked copy.
When a v0.8 specification.xbrief.json with xBRIEFInfo is given, spec:render and project:export-spec full-spec return success instead of rejecting the envelope.
When validation fails on a legacy version, the remediation text rejects task migrate:vbrief and shows the live migrate:xbrief verb.
When render tests run they validate the shared constants; when task check runs it returns exit 0; CHANGELOG Unreleased records the fix.
